title: Version 1.54.0
html:
Version 1.54.0

April 14th, 2024

Added:

  • Viginette and a tiny bit of noise is added to the screen
  • A new area has appeared in Oaklands, the Flowering Meadows! Along it, a new shop: Flora Laura
  • Sakura trees have been added to the game
  • Many new flowers have been added to the game, good luck finding them all! There are rare ones as well.
  • Fruits are now here! They are found in trees, and can be directly picked. Chopping the tree will result in a % of them dying.
  • Two machines have been added: the Dye and Press. They are used for creating dyes, jams, and applying said dyes to different objects.
  • Vases have been added, they can be dyed with the dye machine.
  • Five different types of fabric material have been added, available at Flora Laura, and can be dyed and used in builds!
  • A new Sakura Lantern has been added.
  • An easter shop, as well as a St. Patricks shop has popped up in Oaklands. They will be removed 1 month from this update.
  • Two new gifts have been added for this event, which will be removed 1 month from now. They will not return to Oaklands!
  • Clover trees are here for St. Patricks! They will remain in the game after, but will be more rare. Pots of gold spawn randomly around the map, these will return next year.

Changes:

  • The material laser now triggers for any material if the laser has no material assigned
  • Vehicle Spawn Pads, Spawn Locations, and Privacy Glass can now have their collision removed with a collider
  • Fireflies and ghosts now show their type as their name, rather than just saying "Jar"
  • Nerfed the value of Plek by 15%, the value of Spruce by 30%, and the value of Blue Pine by 50%
  • Nerfed the value of Flameslate by 25%

Fixes:

  • ACTUALLY fixed the anniversary cake collision box
  • There's likely other fixes we forgot to mention, sorry

Version 1.54.1

April 14th, 2024

Fixes:

  • Fixed Press not working the first time it was placed down.
  • Fixed the Growai

Version 1.54.2

April 15th, 2024

Changes:

  • Adjusted Tulip Values from 75 per to 25 per due to their common spawns
  • The gold coin now has a cylinder hitbox instead of a square one

Fixes:

  • Fixed an issue where rocks would retain ownership upon leaving
  • Fixed Burning Blossom's Name & Description
  • Fixed Frisply Clover not spawning correctly (found in the Desert)
  • Fixed Clover's Translation Strings
  • Fixed the Interactor being able to interact with placed wires
  • Fixed Sean's Headwear not being able to be inspected
  • Fixed the Easter Moai not appearing in the Easter Store 😉
  • Fixed the statistic tool producing gibberish for the Dye and Press Machines
  • Fixed the weather sensor not outputting the right number for rain storms
  • Fixed alignment conveyors moving the contents of crates
  • Fixed alignment conveyors moving anchored items, including crates
  • Fixed the singular brick not being able to fill schematics correctly
  • Fixed Fungoidite creating black text for signs

Version 1.54.3

April 17th, 2024

Added:

  • New vehicle & trailer models! This is part of our plan to introduce new modes of transportation into the game :) (Box art coming soon.)
  • Added a new Starter Pack DevProduct for users with a playtime less than 2 hours for 99 Robux
  • Added support to the Filter Conveyor to filter jar types as well as fabrics
  • Added the new UGC to the store page

Changed:

  • Changed the value of Hydrangea 100 -> 50, Berries 250 -> 100, Orange & Lemon 300 -> 250, Pear 275 -> 175, Rose 200 -> 150, Sunflower 125 -> 100
  • Changed the multiplier of dyes and fruits in jars from 6x -> 3x
  • Changed the Sakura's planked color to be a pink color
  • Changed the fill requirement for plane schematics, as well as the sliding door
  • Allowed the Alignment Conveyor and Borderless Conveyor to be sized the same amount as normal conveyors
  • Removed the ability to sell empty jars due to confusion
  • Removed the tutorial ruins due to general user confusion and annoyance

Fixes:

  • Fixed flowers and fruits not being able to be sold in their raw form
  • Fixed the Easter Moai's name & description
  • Fixed the Gurt Painting not being able to be moved
  • Fixed the long-distance streaming mesh for the new Sakura region

Version 1.54.4

Aprit 18th, 2024

Changed:

  • Reverted the vehicle and trailer models for now, we will revise and rerelease them, thank you for the criticism!

Fixes:

  • Fixed client UI error relating to starter pack
  • Fixed the filter conveyor

Version 1.54.5

April 19th, 2024

Added:

  • Added a setting for toggling sprint rather than holding to sprint
  • A bunch of new main menu scenes have been added!
  • Added support to toggle tube, fairy, heart, and bulb lights
  • Added "/testing" chat command in order to teleport to the testing world. There is also a button in the main menu. (For previous logic testing users, you can access the logic world with '/logic', this is now unmaintained)

Changes:

  • Public switches, sliders, buttons, etc now show Public Interaction for the owner if it is enabled
  • Removed Depth of Field settings options due to a strange bug, will return in the future
  • Changed the money multiplier of dyes and fruits from 3 -> 4 (for jars)

Fixes:

  • Fixed a rare occurrence where greedy land buyer wouldn't be awarded on rejoin
  • Fixed the meteor impact not shaking the screen
  • Fixed opened crates showing wrongful stats about it's contents
  • Fixed renaming slots not showing the preview text
  • Fixed not being able to build at very tall heights
  • Fixed the character's head randomly FLYING off the player's body for SOME reason.. hopefully (Editor's Note: This MIGHT be how the Bodyless Horse was made)
  • Fixed the credits menu not loading Contributors & Special Thanks

Version 1.54.6

April 23rd, 2024

Changes:

  • Reverted 1.54.5 due to a huge notice in performance drops. We are investigating this, patched issues may re-appear.
  • I re-added jars being at 4x, though.

Version 1.54.7

April 27th, 2024

Changed:

  • Items from the starter pack will now spawn more spaced out to prevent the "sellner" fling

Version 1.54.8

April 28th, 2024

Fixed:

  • Fixed starter pack not giving the correct item form causing the sellner box to disappear.
